notes.title: Dungeon Modding is here
notes.content:
✨ Stickforge Patch Notes - build 1.0.0-ea-20250914 ✨


Balance Updates

 Zombie Bite damage reduced: 700 → 250
 Zombie HP reduced: 2000 → 1500


NPC Improvements

 NPCs now chase targets when attacked from long range (ignores max aggro range once engaged).
 Fixed a bug where NPCs continued attacking after death.
 NPCs return to spawn if they wander too far or lose their target:

 While returning, they’re invulnerable and fully heal at spawn.

 Added a threat/aggro system → NPC targeting now depends on player damage.
 New AI modding fields (per NPC):

 ai.aggroLockDuration: aggro lock duration override (ms, default 5000)
 ai.switchThreshold: threat multiplier needed to switch targets (default 1.2)


New Game Mode: Dungeon

 Added Dungeon Mode, with a sample dungeon included.
 VIP/Boss mechanic → the game ends when a designated NPC is defeated.
 Fog of War → unexplored areas are hidden until revealed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/8c95a7b7869a1f9f0bcc51ca59dc981170eb00e6.png

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a server crash that could occur when a match ended.


Coming Soon

 A light web version of Stickforge is in development!
 Play directly in your browser on official servers only (no mods).
 Designed to help new players jump in quickly and grow the community.

notes.title: Stickforge is now on Steam!
notes.content:
The wait is over
Stickforge is now available in Early Access! 

Dive into the ultimate 2D multiplayer stickman sandbox where you can build custom maps, craft unique weapons, and battle or team up with friends in chaotic, physics-based fun. 


[previewyoutube="FMnFvf8PnLo;full"][/previewyoutube]


With full Steam Workshop support, you can share your wild creations and explore endless community-made content. For more details about modding, visit the Stickforge Wiki. 

Face off against tough NPCs, epic bosses, or create your own game modes, the possibilities are endless!


Partnership with VeryGames for Server Hosting
We’re thrilled to announce our partnership with VeryGames, a leading provider of game server hosting, to bring you seamless and reliable dedicated servers for Stickforge! 

Enjoy optimized performance for your multiplayer battles and custom creations. Plus, custom installations are available to tailor your server to your needs. For more details and setup guides, visit the Stickforge Wiki. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/101d6ad4bfd7ed09c9736d18b2f3d0bf7a1d41aa.png"]


Roadmap Highlights 
Get a sneak peek at what’s coming for Stickforge in Early Access! Based on our roadmap, here’s what you can expect:

August 19th, 2025: Early Access launch!

Soon: Vehicles and mounts with improved physics.

Q4 2025: Scripting, bosses, dungeons, quests system, and PvE improvements.

Later: Multi-map and destructible environments with voxel + procedural generation.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/7b77e61934026dc9e7b4dba0b52f3cc5505daf75.png"]

Stay tuned for updates as we continue to expand the Stickforge universe together!

Join the community on Discord to participate.

notes.title: Stickforge Demo launches! ✨
notes.content:
THIS IS IT!

After years of development, the demo for Stickforge - the 2D sandbox multiplayer stickman game with epic modding - is finally here!
This is a childhood dream coming to life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/fa34412458587f557d74007a81ab4414aa0a1eea.jpg
This demo offers a taste of Stickforge's core multiplayer experience: experiment with a variety of items, play with physics, and test your most creative combat setups, solo or with friends!

Key Features in the Demo:


Chaotic multiplayer battles with up to 24 players
Game modes: Free-For-All and Conquer Points
Physics-based stickman combat
A curated set of weapons and items to try out
Level cap set to 5
Playable only on official Stickforge servers
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/1f09b8088696d1e162e278ff9786429c1065c4b6.jpg
This is just the beginning of an epic, community-driven journey.
The full version of Stickforge launches in Early Access on June 19th, featuring no level cap, full modding support, and dedicated servers.

Play the demo with your friends, and if you enjoy it, wishlist the full game and leave a review!

Your support means the world and helps bring Stickforge to life.
See you in-game!

Join our Discord
Follow @StickforgeGame on X

notes.title: Development Update & Upcoming Playtest
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Just wanted to share a quick update! Development on StickForge is going really well and I'm currently in the polishing, modding tuning phase, and getting everything ready for the next big steps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/46170f65f3e767cb8c556663de98b2aa1b0ab729.gif

I’ll be running a playtest on May 6th, 7th, and 8th, and I’d love for you to join in. It’s a great chance to test things out, gather feedback, and smash some stickmen together!

Fill out the form to join: Playtest invitation

A demo will follow a week or two after the playtest. It won’t support custom servers yet, but it’ll give everyone a solid feel for the game.

Then comes the big milestone: Early Access is planned for June, with support for dedicated servers, map creation, mods, and all the fun tools to start shaping StickForge together with the community.

It’s been a wild ride building this solo, and I’m incredibly excited for what’s next.

👉 Join the Discord to stay in the loop
👉 Please wishlist the game on Steam if you haven’t already because it really helps!
👉 Check out stickforge.com


Thanks for the support, and see you in the playtest!

PS: Don't play with a mine at home.
